name: Orb · SHDR-12
description: A ball built from glossy toy bricks: a DDA march through a staggered brickwork lattice — layers alternate their bond direction and every course staggers by a hashed offset, so seams never stack — with studs embossed on every upward face, joints drawn only on true brick boundaries, five tunable plastic colours slidable from per-brick confetti to big moulded patches, and a white Blinn sheen. Thinking blinks bricks out of the outer courses and back, the ball visibly rebuilding itself; speaking snaps it whole, fast and glossy (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-12 (MIT).
